title: Ukraine’s Glide Bomb Challenge Is Scale

author: Megaprojects
description:
Russia has resurrected expired training missiles from dusty warehouses, converting them into the RM-48U "Frankenstein" weapon now dominating its bombardment campaign. These modified munitions travel at Mach six but land roughly 300 metres off-target. Moscow's strategy: drain Ukrainian interceptor stocks with cheaper missiles while saving precision weapons for winter strikes.
